# Morpheus, vendored

The UI kit the page is built from: <https://github.com/romshark/morpheus>.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Version | v0.1.0 |
| Commit | `8842c6aab9aaf398d0f164fa0d4066a819eda85e` |
| License | MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE) |

Taken from the kit's own deliverable directory,
[`min/`](https://github.com/romshark/morpheus/tree/main/min), which is committed
upstream so downstream users can vendor straight from GitHub:

| File | From | Is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bundle.js` | `min/bundle.js` | every web component, one ES module |
| `morpheus.css` | `min/morpheus.css` | the light-DOM styles of those components |

`min/theme-default.css` is deliberately **not** vendored. It's the kit's neutral
palette, and this page has its own — [../../style.css](../../style.css) sets the
role tokens it would have set (`--accent`, `--page-bg`, `--btn-border`, …) from
the gqlhash palette instead. Taking both would also mean fighting its
`:root:not(.light):not(.dark)` dark-mode rule, which outranks a plain `:root`.

`<neo-icon>` fetches `<name>.svg` from `--neo-icon-base`, so the icons the page
uses are vendored separately into [../../../public/icons](../../../public/icons)
— a dozen of the kit's [Lucide](https://lucide.dev) set, ISC licensed, each
carrying its license comment.

## Updating

Copy the two files out of a newer `min/`, replace the icons if the set changed,
and check the version and commit above. Nothing here is generated by our build,
so a copy is the whole update.
